captions.detailed: This 3D model features a complete bicycle saddle assembly mounted on a functional dropper seatpost. It consists of a curved black saddle top supported by metallic rails, which are clamped to a dual-bolt rail clamp plate. The post features a telescoping inner tube that slides vertically inside a black outer tube, locked in place by a collar mechanism equipped with a small lever. A standard binder ring is clamped near the base of the outer post.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a dropper seatpost and saddle assembly. The assembly should feature a curved black saddle, metallic rails, a two-bolt rail clamp, a black telescoping inner post on a prismatic joint, a locking collar with a lever, and a bottom seat tube binder ring.
captions.factory: The code constructs an articulated assembly consisting of three main parts. First, the fixed base is modeled using a cylindrical outer tube, a block-based binder ring at the bottom, and a locking collar block at the top containing a small lever. Second, the telescoping inner post is created as a cylinder with a prismatic joint moving along the Z-axis. Third, the saddle assembly is built on top, featuring a dual-bolt clamp plate, metallic support rails modeled from cylinders, and a curved saddle top constructed by lofting or extruding curved profiles.
